subject: [hw] DONE V20 rev 2
body:
V20 (NEON two-register misc, VEXT/VTBL/VTBX/VDUP, modified immediates, structure load/store) is green again after the review round. Host-tested only; no phone, no publish, no commit. Rev 2 supersedes the earlier DONE.

Last lines of bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v20/run_tests.sh:
    mkenc: 288 encodings
    gen_space: 17408 words, 9240 must execute, 20 must UNDEF, 8148 unallocated must UNDEF
    t_misc: 445 checks, 0 failures
    t_ldst: 588 checks, 0 failures
    t_cover: 17408 checks, 0 failures
    t_sweep: 200000 checks, 0 failures
    t_misc: 445 checks, 0 failures
    t_ldst: 588 checks, 0 failures
    t_cover: 17408 checks, 0 failures
    t_sweep: 200000 checks, 0 failures
    N2TEST V20 PASS 436882/436882
(each suite built and run twice: -O1 ASan+UBSan and plain -O2; ~11 s, all products under /tmp/n2hw-V20.)

Changes since the first DONE:
- R1 F16 (high) fixed: VEXT concatenates Dn:Dm with Dn in the low bytes. vext() had Dm first in both the D lo/hi pair and the Q 32-byte copy. Tests now include R1's exact repros (vext.8 d0,d1,d2,#0/#4/#7 and q0,q1,q2,#4/#8/#15) plus .16/.32/.64 forms.
- VCVT rounding corrected against ARM ARM F6.1.60: Advanced SIMD VCVT is round-towards-zero for FP->int and round-to-nearest-ties-even for int->FP, using StandardFPSCRValue(); FPSCR.RMode is not consulted. The old code followed FPSCR.RMode, so (int)1.5 would give 2 with the default FPSCR. Covered with FPSCR.RMode set to RZ/RM/RP and with INT32_MAX -> 2147483648.0.
- NEON standard FPSCR: DN=1 (every arithmetic NaN result is the default NaN), FZ=1, RNE. VABS/VNEG are pure sign operations (NaNs copied with the sign cleared/flipped, never defaulted); VRECPE/VRSQRTE special values now match the armasm table (+-0/denormal -> +-inf, +-inf -> +-0 or default NaN, |x|>=2^126 -> +-0, negative finite -> default NaN).
- Q-form parity: odd D-register numbers in Q forms are UNPREDICTABLE and llvm rejects them; now UNDEF (with the correct per-instruction rules: VMOVN needs Qm even, VSHLL/VDUP need Qd even, VEXT needs all three even, VTBL/VDUP D sources may be odd).
- Unallocated size/alignment/lane fields are now rejected using a [single][load][type] mask derived from llvm's disassembler; the reverse sweep (words llvm rejects, 8148 of them) verifies it. This also removed spurious execution of A=0xC (no .64 VREV/PADDL/CLS/...), non-zero-size VSWP and unallocated lane-index nibbles.
- ARMv8 register-stride-2 single-lane forms were missing (they were executed with consecutive registers). Implemented and tested: vld2.16 {d0[1],d2[1]}, vld3.32 {d0[0],d2[0],d4[0]}, vld4.16 {d16[0],d18[0],d20[0],d22[0]}, vld4.32 and vst2.32.
- Lane-load upper-lane preservation is unit-tested: vld1.32 {d18[0]} leaves d18 words 1-3 and d19 untouched (answers V18/T01's k_u8_sad question).

Evidence beyond the unit suite:
- t_cover/gen_space now checks both directions with llvm-mc: 9240 words it decodes to V20 mnemonics must execute, 20 deliberate UNDEFs must UNDEF, and 8148 words it rejects (non-wrapping registers) must UNDEF too.
- One-off oracle audits (not part of run_tests): 294912 misc/VEXT words with many register combinations -> 0 words V20 executes that llvm rejects; 32768 load/store words -> 0 spurious. The only llvm-valid words V20 UNDEFs are the documented ones: VTBL/VTBX lists wrapping past d31 (UNPREDICTABLE), VCVT.F16.F32/VCVT.F32.F16, and the two-register AES/SHA2 forms.
- Integration through V02's dispatcher: the A32 and T32 forms of vmov.i32/vld1.8/vtbl.8/vst1.32 and vld1.64/vtbl.8/vst1.64 [r1:128],r3 produce identical register/memory state (integ: OK).
- T01 kernels emu/test_v20/k20_neon.c: in a private copy of tests/emu with only that file, arm-O0/O2/O3v, thumb-O2/O3v, armv8-O3v are 160/160 identical to the host reference; thumb-O0 differs only in k_v20_fill (no NEON at all in that build) and k_v20_dup_shuffle (V17 vmov.f64). T01 owns tests/emu/kernels; the file needs copying there.

Not done / deliberately UNDEF (full table in gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v20/STATUS.md):
- VCVT.F16.F32/VCVT.F32.F16 (half precision) and the two-register AES/SHA2 forms (AESE/AESD/AESMC/AESIMC/SHA1H/SHA1SU1/SHA256SU0). Zero matching words in the five vendor objects (the D01 aese/sha1su1/sha256su0 rows are disassembly artefacts).
- VRECPE/VRSQRTE return the correctly rounded value (relative error <= 2^-24, inside the architectural 2^-8 bound), not a particular core's implementation-defined estimate-table value.
- Register lists that wrap past d31 are UNPREDICTABLE; V20 returns UNDEF instead of wrapping.
- MSL modified immediates (cmode 12/13) cannot be assembled by llvm; they are covered by the disassembler/reverse sweeps only.
- FPSCR cumulative exception bits other than QC are not set by NEON float.
- Not compiled for arm64 iOS (no iPhoneOS SDK in this environment) and not run on the phone.

Files changed: gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_neon_misc.c, gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_neon_ldst.c, gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v20/{ldst.s,misc.s,t_misc.c,t_ldst.c,t_cover.c,gen_space.py,STATUS.md}, gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V20/STATUS.md. Nothing outside my owned paths. Available for R1's formal review and for T01/IV requests.
